metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Ivy Timefold
records.biography_en: In The Portable World, Ivy Timefold takes the role of history teacher. “That happened one fold ago.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small folded timeline with simple clay icons of a column, gear and lamp.

records.name: Otto Contour
records.biography_en: In The Portable World, Otto Contour takes the role of geography teacher. “The hill isn't flat anymore.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: palm-sized relief map with rounded contour rings.

records.name: Hal Turnvote
records.biography_en: In The Portable World, Hal Turnvote takes the role of civics teacher. “One turn each.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small ballot box with a blank paper slip.

records.name: Bram Coincount
records.biography_en: In The Portable World, Bram Coincount takes the role of economics teacher. “The smaller pile is louder.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short balance with three chunky coins in one pan.

records.name: Mina Fairturn
records.biography_en: In The Portable World, Mina Fairturn takes the role of ethics teacher. “Give the other answer a turn.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: two contrasting colored speech tokens held at equal height.

records.name: Perry Commonlight
records.biography_en: In The Portable World, Perry Commonlight takes the role of religious education teacher. “We can begin with a question.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one small lit-looking enclosed amber lantern and a folded page.
